mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies near Badger Ridge Middle School at 57 degrees. Please note the air quality index is at a moderate 81. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon tonight, and while the ISS is passing overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will dip to 52 degrees with no rain expected.

The City of Verona has announced that the Plan Commission will meet on Wednesday, November 4th, to review several development proposals, including the Ardent Glen third addition, property at 1979 Milky Way, and certified survey maps for Jenna Drive and Range Trail. Additionally, residents are reminded that tax bills will be mailed by December 15th, with payment options including online, by mail, or at the 24/7 City Center drop box.

There is plenty to do in our area. Tomorrow, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking further ahead, join us for yoga at Insight Wellness on October 26th, trivia nights at Hop Haus and the Bogey Factory starting October 27th, and more.

On Thursday, October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I after receiving reports of dangerous driving while students were on board. Fortunately, no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor was Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. As the store is now closed for the night, we invite you to stop by tomorrow starting at 10:00 AM to enjoy our flavor of the day, which will be Turtle.
